'''Squirrel''' is an organ harvester {{In|FOTV}}.<ref name="FalloutTV 4">{{fotv|1|4}}</ref>

==Background==
Squirrel, together with [[Huey]], manages the organ harvesting business at the [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]] with the help of their medical [[Mr. Handy]] robot [[Snip Snip]].<ref name="FalloutTV 4" /> They are under the protection of [[Sorrel Booker]]'s "[[Govermint]]."<ref name="FalloutTV 6">{{fotv|1|6}}</ref>

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Ghouls]]===
Within the Super Duper Mart, Squirrel sits on a couch beside Huey, watching a pre-War cartoon on their [[Television|TV]] while eating a cup of ramen. Soon, Snip Snip arrives with [[Lucy MacLean]] tied to a stretcher and announces to them that their latest "arrival" has arrived. For the most part, Squirrel ate his ramen as Huey talked to Snip about what to do with Lucy, and when they left, Huey mentioned to Squirrel how nice Snip Snip was.<ref name="FalloutTV 4" />

Afterward, Lucy returns to the two harvesters and demands that Squirrel and Huey raise their hands or else Snip Snip would get hurt. However, Huey didn't care, citing it was just a fucking robot, and Squirrel backed up Lucy's futile attempt to get them to surrender, noting it's like holding an air conditioner hostage. This would lead to a brief chat about the perks of owning one and whether Lucy knows what it means.<ref name="FalloutTV 4" />

Lucy then lifts up one of Snip Snip's arms, revealing she's converted it into a makeshift [[weapon]] that fires off syringes filled with [[Abraxo]] draining fluid. She then has Snip Snip recite the Abraxo jingle, where part of it notes that it's very poisonous. Because of the situation, Huey allows Lucy to go free, but she wants the captive [[ghoul]]s to be released. Looking toward Squirrel, who nods slightly, Huey releases the non-feral ghouls.<ref name="FalloutTV 4" />

Seeing that not all of the ghouls were released, one in particular who changed her name, "[[Martha (TV series)|Martha]]," Lucy demanded that the remainder be released. Huey tries to reason with Lucy, but she fires off her weapon, and the dart shot out of it hits the couch and begins to erode it a bit, leaving the two shocked by what they've witnessed. Left with no other choice, Huey releases the remaining ones, who all turn out to be [[Feral ghoul|feral]], and attacks them.<ref name="FalloutTV 4" />

Immediately, the two fired their weapons at the feral ghouls, and Squirrel was lunged and eaten by one, which Huey killed. After the two organ harvesters are dead, Lucy takes a brief moment to look at their corpses. A little later, their corpses can be seen when [[the Ghoul]] enters the area where they died and helps himself to their vials, booze, and the use of their TV.<ref name="FalloutTV 4" />
